final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_ownership_difference FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_difference) AS avg_event_difference FROM event_averages) SELECT e.corpeventprx, e.avg_anlycount, e.avg_ownership_difference, e.avg_ownership_difference - o.avg_event_difference AS difference_from_event_average FROM event_averages AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_event_difference IS NOT NULL
